messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that can interact with a computer shell to solve programming tasks.

<pr_description>
Consider the following PR description:
Autodoc extension's mock file throws TypeError for generic-typed classes.
**Describe the bug**
When building the docs for a generically-typed class, a TypeError is thrown as Autodoc's `mock._make_subclass` attempts to concatenate a `str` to a `TypeVar`. See the attached log: [sphinx-err-325ndteh.log](https://github.com/sphinx-doc/sphinx/files/4842672/sphinx-err-325ndteh.log)


**To Reproduce**
```
$ git https://github.com/perrygoy/screenpy.git
$ cd screenpy/docs
$ python -m venv env
$ source env/bin/activate
$ pip install sphinx pyhamcrest selenium typing_extensions
$ make html
```
Observe the docs command fails with a TypeError.

**Expected behavior**
Docs can still be built when generics are involved.

**Your project**
https://github.com/perrygoy/screenpy.git

**Environment info**
- OS: Mac 10.15.5 (19F101)
- Python version: 3.7.7
- Sphinx version: 3.1.1
- Sphinx extensions:  sphinx.ext.autodoc, sphinx.ext.intersphinx, sphinx.ext.coverage, sphinx.ext.ifconfig, sphinx.ext.napoleon

**Additional context**
This might just be me not knowing how to make Sphinx-friendly generic typing, if that's the case please let me know!

</pr_description>

path = Path('sphinx/ext/autodoc/mock.py')
text = path.read_text(encoding='utf8')

# Insert helper function just before _make_subclass definition
marker = "\n\ndef _make_subclass("
if marker not in text:
    raise SystemExit('marker not found')

helper = "\n\ndef _name_for_mock(obj: Any) -> str:\n" \
         "    \"\"\"Return a safe name for a mocked object.\n\n" \
         "    The autodoc mock objects are sometimes subscripted with non-string\n" \
         "    values (ex. ``TypeVar`` for generic-typed classes like ``Foo[T]``).\n" \
         "    ``type()`` requires the class name to be a string, and we also want\n" \
         "    ``__display_name__`` to always be a string.\n" \
         "    \"\"\"\n" \
         "    if isinstance(obj, str):\n" \
         "        return obj\n\n" \
         "    for attr in ('__qualname__', '__name__'):\n" \
         "        value = getattr(obj, attr, None)\n" \
         "        if isinstance(value, str) and value:\n" \
         "            return value\n\n" \
         "    try:\n" \
         "        return str(obj)\n" \
         "    except Exception:\n" \
         "        try:\n" \
         "            return repr(obj)\n" \
         "        except Exception:\n" \
         "            return object.__repr__(obj)\n"

if '_name_for_mock' not in text:
    text = text.replace(marker, helper + marker)

# Replace _make_subclass body to use helper
import re
pattern = re.compile(r"def _make_subclass\(name: Any, module: str, superclass: Any = _MockObject,\n\s+attributes: Any = None\) -> Any:\n(?P<body>(?:.*\n)*?)\n\nclass _MockModule", re.M)
match = pattern.search(text)
if not match:
    raise SystemExit('function block not found')

new_func = (
"def _make_subclass(name: Any, module: str, superclass: Any = _MockObject,\n"
"                   attributes: Any = None) -> Any:\n"
"    name_str = _name_for_mock(name)\n"
"    module_str = module if isinstance(module, str) else str(module)\n\n"
"    attrs = {'__module__': module_str,\n"
"             '__display_name__': module_str + '.' + name_str}\n"
"    attrs.update(attributes or {})\n\n"
"    return type(name_str, (superclass,), attrs)\n"
)

# Replace existing function definition + body
start = match.start()
end = match.end()
# isolate portion up to class _MockModule
before = text[:start]
after = text[end - len("\n\nclass _MockModule"):]
text = before + new_func + after

path.write_text(text, encoding='utf8')
print('patched')
